recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to current modules.css diagram sizing or other responsive design behavior should be handled as new UI/design work, not as an unapplied FHIR-11444 fix.
issue_request: FHIR-11444 was a Published FHIR-core index-page issue from the DSTU2-era 2016-09 publication. It reported that the page/diagram did not use the available width; the final Persuasive with Modification resolution was to improve it, and the Jira application comment says it was fixed by changing div-9 to div-12.
initial_application: No commit explicitly named FHIR-11444, but the matching source history is present. Commit 2e5325bdee changed source/index.html and related top-level pages from col-9 to col-12 in February 2017, and commit 66f032b79d later made the same home-page-specific col-9 to col-12 correction with a rationale about there being no right-hand column.
additional_context: The current source/index.html is the active home-page source and includes source/modules-fragment.html directly. A 2021 template update, d7b8dadc, removed the old col-12 wrapper from source/index.html entirely; current source has no col-9 or col-12 wrapper to correct. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The applied historical fix is reflected in source history, and the current page layout no longer contains the obsolete Bootstrap width wrapper targeted by the issue.
